QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_64

question.text: An AIF must complete at least how long from First Close before being required to provide data to Benchmarking Agencies?

answer.text: At least one year from First Close

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 6.3 Box 6.2(b), AIFs must have completed at least one year from First Close. **The Trap:** 3/6 months too short; 3 years too long. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same cadence for Cat I/II (XIX-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Diary the 1-year anniversary and engage Benchmarking Agency 60 days ahead.
